headline: Ryanair's CEO says pilot and cabin-crew hiring has slowed; an earlier plan to speed up cadet and FO hiring for the MAX 10 is reported as reversed
why_it_matters: Ryanair is the biggest door for fresh EASA fATPLs; expect slower progress from assessment to course date. No new hiring number published

headline: KLM plans to cut almost 15% more positions, swap planned A320s for E195-E2s and grow Cityhopper; it says its pilot shortage is largely resolved
why_it_matters: Less urgency in KLM pilot hiring; the experienced-pilot vacancy is still listed but low-hours chances look thinner

headline: Airbus and Blue Angels Air agree an ab-initio programme: Indian cadets train to EASA standard in Tunisia from 2027, then convert to a DGCA licence
why_it_matters: Another EASA-standard route aimed at India, where airlines need large numbers of new pilots

headline: Ryanair's half-year profit fell about 15% and it warned that temporary pay freezes may be needed; MAX 10 deliveries start spring 2027
why_it_matters: Growth is capped by aircraft supply, so cadet intakes may stay steady rather than expand; unclear if pilot pay is affected

headline: Condor pilots accept a two-year pay freeze, then 7% from October 2028, in return for no compulsory redundancies until September 2029
why_it_matters: Strong job security at Condor, but frozen pay scales and no hiring numbers attached

headline: SWISS will end its airBaltic wet lease after winter 2026/27 and fly more A320s with its own crews from summer 2027
why_it_matters: More in-house SWISS flying could create crew demand; no hiring figure published yet

headline: airBaltic, in Chapter 11, moves to cut around 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew, according to the Latvian Aviation Union
why_it_matters: More experienced A220 pilots on the market means more competition for regional FO seats
